text:
miguel: quick follow-up on preempt window idea for Frontdoor -> gateways. goal: graceful reclaim of long-lived streams under pressure.

anna: outline please? simple flow.

miguel: Frontdoor accepts OPEN, marks conn preemptable, mints signed token (T) with id|expiry|epoch, injects x-rw-preempt: T. on reclaim, Frontdoor issues REVOKE(id, epoch). gateway treats as soft revoke then hard after drain_timeout.

sam: sketch:
Client->Frontdoor: OPEN {id, tenant, preemptable=true}
Frontdoor->Upstream: request + header x-rw-preempt: T
...streaming...
Frontdoor->Upstream: REVOKE {id, epoch} (soft)
Gateway: finish inflight, close after drain_timeout (hard)

irene: concerns: side effects if killed mid-stream, and hedging/late-bind: multiple upstreams may exist.

sam: hedging fix: include epoch+nonce in T so only matching upstream honors REVOKE. other hedged copies ignore unless token matches. requires token propagation to all fanouts.

anna: security: T must be HMAC-signed and short-lived. format: base64(id|expiry|epoch|hmac).

irene: observability: emit span event revoke=soft/hard, counters revoke.soft/revoke.hard, log tenant/quota bucket.

miguel: ops: avoid thrash when many tenants revoked at once — stagger drain_timeout randomized per-conn or per-tenant backoff. cost: extra header parsing + HMAC verify per new stream.

ops-bot: simulated sweep at 15:17 UTC: avg drain 210ms, no 5xx.

sam: impl note: opaque signed tokens avoid control-plane lookups. maintain small recent-epoch bitmap for hard-revoke lookups.

anna: i'll prototype token verification snippet EOW.

miguel: i'll open RFC PR with sequence diagrams and perf estimate. @sam add hedging interaction. canary: tenant-scoped revokes only.

ops-bot: reminder: link RFC issue when ready.
